checks.title: Full Diagnostic Coverage
checks.description: ColdMailer runs nine technical checks in parallel so your freelance clients receive deliverability reports backed by real infrastructure data, not guesswork.

items.checkDns: Resolve authoritative records to confirm the domain is live and properly delegated.
items.checkDomainAge: Score domain maturity to flag recently registered burner assets used in spam blasts.
items.checkMxRecords: Interrogate MX endpoints and priority chains to validate that the inbox can receive mail.
items.checkSmtp: Simulate transactional SMTP conversations to detect greylisting, throttling, and hard rejections.
items.hasSuspiciousPatterns: Identify typo-squatting, homoglyph attacks, and sequencing anomalies common in fake signups.
items.isDisposable: Cross-reference disposable hosts to keep temporary inboxes off your client deliverables.
items.isFreeDomain: Highlight free mailbox providers when brands demand corporate-only outreach.
items.isRoleAccount: Filter support, info, and other role-based addresses that rarely engage with freelance cold pitches.
items.validateSyntax: Apply RFC-compliant parsing to eliminate malformed inputs before they reach the sending queue.
